events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: One-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis with eight chefs serving CookUnity dishes.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made meals and hot bites while supplies last; guests also receive a bodega-style scratch-off ticket for prize chances.
events.caveats: Walk-in public giveaway with no advance RSVP requirement found. Food is explicitly while supplies last; arriving does not guarantee a meal after inventory is exhausted.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17 only, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Five participating locations: Flatiron, Chelsea, Midtown, West Village and Murray Hill.

occurrences.details: Walk-in at any of five participating Manhattan locations. Complimentary meals/hot bites are available while supplies last.
